summary: The copy mostly sounds like DUMMIES: dry, bureaucratic and worker-voiced, with the canonical D9.3 lines used as intended. Two lines break truth rules: a honk bark claims the car is on schedule when the sim only logged that it was blocked, and a FLEET label names the learned counter before the player has met the changed return.

issues.found: {model} is on schedule. Please clear the lane.
issues.rule: Barks may not assert facts the simulation did not log. A honk event only establishes that the car has been blocked for more than 5 s, so claiming it is on schedule is a vivid false claim.
Explanatory copy naming a model's learned counter is deferred until the player has met the changed return. The HUD may mark a changed record but must not name the counter.
